I saw your Content Creator opening and wanted to write straight away. I have built and launched a ~600-page website for a pharmacists' association, produced Dutch landing pages for a Google Ads test that earned a 4.57% CTR and 53 clicks, and I use Canva daily to turn technical topics into clear visuals. Your mix of property inspections, valuations and technical audits is exactly the kind of expertise that deserves content people actually understand and trust.

I work in English every day and I write and speak Dutch at a working level. I have my own car, so the daily trip to your Brussels office is no problem.

In the first weeks I would map your content calendar, audit your current channels for brand consistency, and start producing short videos and posts that show what a BEREX inspection really looks like. I would love to talk through how I can help strengthen your brand and digital presence.

Best regards,

Dear BEREX team,

I am writing to apply for the Content Creator role. What caught my attention is how BEREX combines real estate expertise with modern digital tools to make inspections, valuations and handovers clear and accessible. That is exactly the kind of content I enjoy creating: taking something technical and making it engaging across social media, video and articles.

At Episto I built and launched around 600 member profile pages on one consistent layout for a pharmacists' association, which taught me how to manage a large content project and keep every page on-brand. As a freelancer I ran a self-funded Google Ads test for a kids' bike brand in Belgium and the Netherlands: I built two Dutch landing pages, chose buyer-intent keywords and presented the results to their team, achieving a 4.57% CTR and 53 clicks. I use Canva daily for visuals and I have hands-on experience editing photo and video content for different platforms. My background in front-end development means I can also build and tweak landing pages without waiting on anyone.

I work in English every day and I write and speak Dutch at a working level. I have my own car, so the daily trip to your Brussels office is no problem.

In the first weeks I would sit down with your marketing team to map a content calendar, audit your current channels for brand consistency, and start producing short videos and posts that show what a BEREX inspection really looks like. I would love to talk through how I can help strengthen your brand and digital presence.

Best regards,
Baver Ok
+32 470 42 48 36
baverok@gmail.com

## SUMMARY
I create content that reflects a brand's expertise and brings in the right audience. At Episto I run keyword research, local and mobile SEO and link building for consulting, auto and e-commerce clients, and I support a WooCommerce webshop with catalogue and product content. As a freelancer I build Dutch landing pages, write and present proposals, and sell AI search visibility and marketing automation. I built kxp.be single-handedly in WordPress in English, Dutch and French, and I design and publish my own apps. I am analytical, follow search and social trends closely, and eager to learn.

- Support a WooCommerce webshop ([proteinbox.com.tr](https://proteinbox.com.tr)) with catalogue, product content and conversion pages
- Run keyword research, local and mobile SEO and link building for consulting, auto and e-commerce clients
- **~600 member profile pages** built and launched on one consistent layout for a pharmacists' association
- Track KPIs (rankings, traffic, CTR) in Semrush, Ahrefs, GA4 and Search Console and report on results

### Freelance Digital Marketer – [baverok.com](https://baverok.com), 09/2026 – Present

### Web & SEO Specialist – Knowledge Experts ([KXP](https://kxp.be)), 01/2024 – 02/2026

## PROJECTS & PRODUCTS

### PupSmart – AI dog-care app on [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.momoco.pupsmart)

### AI job-search assistant
